checks: Turning keeps chrome and the actual outgoing paper mounted; transparent scene has no full-page brightness filter
Fold screenshots captured in both themes with a textured back and crease shadow
Drag directly controls the fold; Escape restores the original paper; release continues from the same fold
Interrupted rebound and resize retain the original sheet and keep its page number synchronized
Rapid reversal reaches the newest page; spread uses one folding leaf and the printed reverse side
Spread boundary drags clamp to a valid page and returning the pointer fully flattens the fold
Portrait/tablet and phone folds support both axes and keyboard corner activation without overflow; printed SVG references stay local
Settings opens without an automatic close-button rectangle; borderless controls retain keyboard focus and pointer close
scope: Chromium desktop, portrait tablet and phone viewports; real devices not exercised; references: https://nodlik.github.io/StPageFlip/
